description: This file contains unit tests for the 'quiche' project's 'quiche_circular_deque' data structure, including tests for constructors, assignment, element access, iteration, resizing, relocation of non-trivially copyable objects, push/pop operations, allocator behavior, and swap functionality.

classes.name: ConfigurableAllocator
classes.description: A template for allocators with configurable propagation traits and equality result.

classes.description: Test fixture class for testing QuicheCircularDeque.

classes.name: Foo
classes.description: A non-trivially copyable class used to test relocation and copying behavior of the deque.
